overview: Kerala Startup Mission Angel Network is part of the Ignite - Investor Education Program, which equips High Net-Worth Individuals (HNIs) and Ultra High Net-Worth Individuals (UHNIs) with knowledge, tools, and frameworks to participate confidently in startup investing. The program focuses on building understanding of the startup investment ecosystem, including deal evaluation, risk assessment, portfolio construction, and long-term value creation. Through structured learning modules, practical tools, and curated access to high-quality startup opportunities, IGNITE enables participants to make informed investment decisions and engage meaningfully as angel investors.
target_beneficiaries: individuals interested in startup and early-stage investments
objectives: Equip HNIs and UHNIs with knowledge, tools, and frameworks to participate confidently in startup investing
Build a strong understanding of the startup investment ecosystem, including deal evaluation, risk assessment, portfolio construction, and long-term value creation
Enable participants to make informed investment decisions and engage meaningfully as angel investors
Strengthen investor capability and confidence to deepen domestic capital participation
Contribute to the sustainable growth of Kerala’s startup ecosystem
eligibility: Eligibility Criteria Applicants must meet the eligibility requirements specified under the scheme guidelines. High Net-Worth Individuals (HNIs) Ultra High Net-Worth Individuals (UHNIs) Individuals interested in startup and early-stage investments
benefits: 01 Structured understanding of startup investing and angel investing 02 Tools and frameworks for deal evaluation and risk assessment 03 Insights into portfolio construction and investment lifecycle 04 Curated access to startups and ecosystem experts 05 Improved confidence in making informed investment decisions
financial_support: The program does not provide direct financial support to startups; it focuses on investor education to enhance angel investing capabilities.
application_process: 1. Apply Now via the KSUM website 2. Submit application through the official KSUM/IGNITE portal during call for proposals 3. Preliminary screening and technical evaluation by KSUM 4. Presentation before the PRAYAS Monitoring Committee (PMC) 5. Evaluation based on innovation, technical feasibility, prototype development plan, and market potential 6. Approval and sanction by competent authority 7. Document Submission 8. Execute agreement prior to fund release 9. Funds released in milestone-based tranches 10. Submit periodic progress reports and utilisation certificates for subsequent tranche release
deadlines: Calls for proposals are issued periodically and published through official channels.
